name: verify_compliance
description: Run the deterministic ProvenPath compliance gate on the current draft proposal. The gate checks all 23 rules across 6 layers (TYPE, RANGE, CONSISTENCY, RULE_MATCH, SOURCE, GROUNDING). Returns PASSED or BLOCKED with named failing rules and reasons. The LLM must not interpret a BLOCKED result as partial compliance — nothing reaches PolicyCenter unless the gate returns PASSED.

executionId.description: Execution ID from propose_product. The draft associated with this execution is verified.
